title: WW1 - Oversimplified (Part 1)
beats: Opens with ironic 'height of civilization, let's have a war' then lists grievances as gossip
Archduke assassination as a comic near-miss story, then 'except no' reversal
Alliance chain told as friends saying 'you got my back?'; Britain 'maybe...'
Schlieffen plan stated as a simple 3-step plan, then 'just one problem' (forts)
Plan forces Belgium route; Belgium resists, Britain joins
'Spot the French soldier' mini-game shows bright uniforms get shot
Eastern front, Marne gap; one-clause definition of flanking
'Here's how trench warfare works' as ordered 4-step cycle
Trench misery list; abrupt end, Part 1 cliff

new_moves.name: plan-then-single-flaw
new_moves.what: State a character's plan as clean steps, then 'just one problem' to drive the next event

new_moves.name: reversal-turn
new_moves.what: Offer the expected outcome then negate it with 'except no' to keep causality surprising

theory: Causality is carried by character intentions and their failed plans, so each event feels motivated rather than listed. Humor and quick persona voices keep the dependency chain light; the only rigorous mini-explanation (trench cycle) is given as an ordered list.
velocity: Orchestrator: template 'plan, flaw, consequence' triples for causal topics
